label: guest burn_chain on RISC Zero 3.1.0, reproducible docker build
reproducibility: two docker builds in two separate target directories, the second after removing its guest output and build-script output and with a changed docker context (so no cached build layer), gave the same ELF sha256 and image id
docker_tag_source: risc0-build 3.0.7 src/lib.rs DEFAULT_DOCKER_TAG = r0.1.97.0 (risc0 v3.1.0 ships risc0-build 3.0.7)
docker_context: repository root (the guest uses crates/lez_chain, which includes programs/bridge/src/hash.rs by path)
command: cd $R && unset RISC0_DOCKER_CONTAINER_TAG && RISC0_HOME=$B/run/w5/risc0-31 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<own dir> BV_GUEST_DOCKER=1 cargo build --release -j 2 --manifest-path guests/burn_chain/Cargo.toml -p burn_chain_host
superseded_local_build_image_id: 0xaa506042cd777a9a957aba3232125155da63d11be269bab8cc6c2f4cb8d4db46 (rzup rust 1.91.1; used by the first executor runs and the first anvil-fork run only)
cross_check: executor journals with this ELF are byte-identical to the native statement and to the journals of the local build (journal-synthetic-{private,public}.hex)
